summary: Lloyds Banking Group plc filed a Form 6-K with the SEC to report a routine admission of 2,535,129 ordinary shares to trading on the London Stock Exchange. The issuance occurred between 1 August and 28 August 2026 to satisfy employee share awards under existing block admissions. Following this issuance, the total shares admitted to trading were 57,994,703,389 as of 28 August 2026. This is a standard share issuance notification under UK Prospectus Rules and does not represent any special situation event.
